note.en: Reports Eusebius for Scythia, Jerome for Achaia, and the later agreement that Andrew was crucified at Patrae. A popular encyclopedia, not the ancient text itself.
Pin for the Shahr-e Qumis site identified with the Parthian city Hecatompylos. Wikipedia is not the only support for the Parthia tradition; that is Eusebius.
